content.content:
1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
2. Source per kind: every kind for which the dependent fixes an inverse states where that inverse comes from, and the stated source is the operation revert of the entries the marker kept. Fail on a kind whose inverse is an unsourced action or a name that leaves its source open — name the kind and the clause — and fail on any clause that lets an inverse be produced by re-deriving a change's content — name the clause. A kind the dependent fixes no inverse for is not this criterion's business.
content.rationale: The refine hands the target a prerequisite that fixes where a change-level operation's inverse comes from, so a license check alone would pass a dependent that names an inverse per kind and leaves its source open — the exact gap the refine closes — and would leave the new edge merely listed. The source check keeps the use sound per kind without restating either node: it names no kind and no clause in advance, so rewording or reshaping the dependent leaves it intact, and it holds the dependent to the prerequisite's fixed source rather than to its wording.
